# ADR index (cross-namespace)

Every Architectural Decision Record across **both** namespaces, in one place — the joint landscape the per-namespace indexes do not give. Generated from each ADR's front-matter; the per-namespace README indexes ([ADR-PC](../../product_concepts/adrs/README.md) · [ADR-IC](../../integration_concepts/adrs/README.md)) carry the full decision summaries.
